name: Bilbao (Spain)
description: White field with a red canton at the upper hoist.
history: The titles, the flag and the arms are the traditional symbols of the town of Bilbao and form part of its historical heritage; the flag is white with a red canton, in a proportion of three parts long by two wide, defined as a white flag with a red die in the upper corner next to the sleeve.

features.role: red square in the upper hoist quarter
